initial_application: The Jira comment identifies GH#db9355a66d. Commit db9355a66d9e549d3043a73c6aef8c9f6e40b46b removed the generator call that emitted a per-implementation-guide category heading using ig.getName(), which was the source of the core heading.

In current core source, publish.ini comments out extensibility-registry.html and core narrative links use [%extensions-location%]extension-registry.html. The Extension Pack declares the page title as "Extension Registry" and its page content does not include the old core-specific heading.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source change is needed because the requested heading removal was already applied and there is no active current core page that can still display the stale heading.
